newsitem.title: GERMANY: Paribas raises Thyssen, Krupp share price targets.
newsitem.headline: Paribas raises Thyssen, Krupp share price targets.

text.p: Paribas bank said on Tuesday it had raised its share price targets for German engineering firms Thyssen and Fried. Krupp Hoesch-Krupp due to a possible takeover of Thyssen by Krupp.
The bank said in a statement it had raised its Thyssen target to 500 marks from 400 marks and for Krupp to 320 marks from 270 marks.

"The financing of a 100 percent stake in Thyssen at 500 marks a share (i.e. 1.6 billion marks) can be reduced by disposing of the E-Plus stake, real estate as well as some non-core activities," Paribas said.
The resulting net debt of 13 billion marks should be more than covered by operating income from Thyssen, the bank said.
Paribas added that it saw a 50 percent chance for the takeover to fall through as antitrust authorities could block the deal and there was a political risk associated with layoffs in Dortmund.
